newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nomura exercises Shandong Xinhua option.
newsitem.headline: Nomura exercises Shandong Xinhua option.

text.p: Shandong Xinhua Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Wednesday that Nomura International (Hong Kong) Ltd exercised its over-allotment option to require the company to issue an additional 5.5 million H-shares at HK$1.82 each.
Shandong Xinhua said the 5.5 million shares represents the remaining 55 percent of the total number of H-shares that the company could have issued under the over-allotment option.
In December, Nomura exercised part of the option, requiring the company to issue 4.5 million H-shares.
On completion of the deal on January 16, there will be a total of 150 million H-shares issued, representing 35.9 percent of Shandong Xinhua's enlarged share capital, it said.
The medicine maker was listed on December 31, 1996. Nomura was the global coordinator and lead manager of the issue.
